notes.title: Lights Camera Slaughter DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for your patience and support, for you those don't know I'm a single indie developer working on my first official game "Lights Camera Slaughter". I have been working on this game for a while now and have finally released the demo - which you can download through Steam! 

I have worked for months and months polishing this demo, and I hope you enjoy this 15-20 minute teaser of what's to come! 

Feedback is welcome and any bugs/issues please contact me or post in the forums!

Enjoy!

Max

notes.title: Lights Camera Slaughter now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

Our Kickstarter is almost ended with up to 29 backers - which is incredible! I'm so excited for everyone to get their hands on this terrifying game! We have now been Steam approved and officially launched onto Steam - which is a huge step for us! I can't wait for you guys to play and see your reactions!

Whilst we are still developing this game, it will be locked for Halloween 2021 - if any delays arise, these will be announced ASAP, however this is unlikely. Once Halloween is upon us, the game will be released and everyone can receive their copy from Kickstarter, or purchase from our Steam store.

If you're interested in following this project - please consider Wishlisting Lights Camera Slaughter - as this helps us a lot!

Thank you,

Max
